productName: Metro-Trio Medical & Critical Illness Protection Plan

trends.whatProductOffers: Accepts applicants aged 40-60 who have diabetes, hypertension or hyperlipidaemia, including HbA1c as high as 10%, with cover guaranteed renewable to age 85.

keyFigures.label: HbA1c accepted
keyFigures.condition: A chance to be covered; underwriting applies

exclusionsOrConditions: Underwriting still applies; HbA1c up to 10% is not guaranteed acceptance.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because {client_detail}, this plan is built for applicants with the three high rather than automatically excluding them.
sourceEvidence: "individuals with HbA1c as high as 10% also has a chance to be covered"
"guaranteed to be renewable up to the insured's age of 85"
trends.notesForReviewer: Acceptance is still subject to underwriting; the extract does not give decline criteria.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays up to HK$500,000 on the ward plan or HK$1,500,000 on the standard private plan per confinement, covered surgical procedure or covered injury, with worldwide medical cover.

keyFigures.label: Ward plan limit
keyFigures.condition: Per confinement, covered surgical procedure or covered injury

keyFigures.label: Standard private limit
keyFigures.condition: Per confinement, covered surgical procedure or covered injury

exclusionsOrConditions: The limit is per confinement, procedure or injury, not an annual or lifetime limit.
Room and board must be within the selected plan level.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the plan lifts medical cover to HK$1.5 million per confinement on the standard private option.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the hospital and room level expected
Check whether treatment may happen overseas
trends.notesForReviewer: The plan has no stated annual or lifetime aggregate limit; the figure is per confinement/procedure/injury.

trends.whatProductOffers: Adds lump-sum cover for 6 critical illnesses and 3 early-stage critical illnesses, including complications related to chronic diseases, cancer and carcinoma-in-situ, plus a death benefit.

keyFigures.label: Lump sum
keyFigures.value: Paid on a covered critical illness

exclusionsOrConditions: Only 6 critical illnesses and 3 early-stage conditions; this is not a broad CI list.
Benefit amounts are not in the extracted text.
clientSignalPhrases: wants a lump sum on diagnosis
clientProfileFit: Clients seeking medical plus lump sum in one policy
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Given {client_detail}, the plan pairs hospital reimbursement with a lump sum on six critical illnesses.
verificationPrompts: Check which conditions the client fears most
Confirm need for a death benefit
sourceEvidence: "cover 6 critical illnesses and 3 early stage critical illnesses including the complications related to chronic diseases, cancer and carcinoma-in-situ"

trends.whatProductOffers: Extends cover beyond inpatient treatment to pre- and post-surgery outpatient consultations, emergency outpatient treatment, rehabilitation and long-term treatment, plus worldwide emergency assistance.

keyFigures.label: Extended benefits
keyFigures.value: Pre- and post-surgery outpatient, emergency outpatient, rehabilitation, long-term treatment

exclusionsOrConditions: This is not a general outpatient plan.
Amounts are not in the extracted text.

sourceEvidence: "extended medical benefits for emergency outpatient treatment and rehabilitation purposes"
"pre- and post-surgery outpatient consultation, long term treatment and worldwide emergency assistance services"
trends.notesForReviewer: No per-visit or annual outpatient limits are given in the extract.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A medical and critical illness plan designed for non-smokers aged 40-60 with diabetes, hypertension or hyperlipidaemia, with limits up to HK$1.5 million and cover to age 85.
notSuitedWhen: The client is under 40 or already over 60
The client wants a broad 50+ condition critical illness list
